newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end firm on foreign buy orders.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end firm on foreign buy orders.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed broadly higher in moderate trade with the bolsa driven by foreign demand, especially for telecom CTC, said dealers.
The market is expected to open stable with no clear direction seen, they said.
The 40-share index ended 0.14 percent higher at 117.11 points. The general firmed 0.33 percent at 5,393.19 points amid volume of 11.5 billion pesos.
Most orders came from New York with local investors remaining on the sidelines, said dealers.

Telecom shares continued to advance on buying from pension funds who are keen to fill their stock quotas before these are reduced by the authorities next week as part of a scheduled rejigging of fund portfolios, they said.
Chilean authorities regularly adjust funds' quotas to encourage them to diversify their investments.
Entel climbed 3.27 percent to 2,840 pesos, while CTC rose 1.67 percent to 3,050 pesos.
Decliners included power utility Endesa, down 0.77 percent at 259 pesos, pulp-maker Copec, down 0.61 percent at 1,620 pesos, and forestry firm Masisa, which shed 0.23 percent to 220 pesos.
